terminals.name: astro-dev
terminals.command: until npx astro dev --port 4891 --host; do echo 'astro dev exited; restarting in 2s'; sleep 2; done
terminals.description: Astro dev server for the portfolio at http://localhost:4891. On a cold Vite cache the Astro + @astrojs/cloudflare dev server re-optimizes SSR deps and can crash on the first boot; this loop auto-restarts until it converges (~15-30s) and then stays stable.
